entries.title: Psalms 129:1
segments: A Song of degrees. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth, Israel may now say;

entries.title: Psalms 129:2
segments: many times they have afflicted me from my youth; yet they have not prevailed over me.

entries.title: Psalms 129:3
segments: The plowers plowed on my back; they made their furrows long.

entries.title: Psalms 129:4
segments: The LORD [is] righteous; He cuts off the cords of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 129:5
segments: Let them all be ashamed and turned back, those who hate Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 129:6
segments: Let them be like the grass [on] the housetops, which dries up before it grows up,

entries.title: Psalms 129:7
segments: with which the reaper does not fill his hand, nor the binder of sheaves his bosom.

entries.title: Psalms 129:8
segments: And those who pass by have never said, The blessing of the LORD [be] on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.
